credits_text: THOMAS H. INCE presents, DOROTHY DALTON in "The Dark Mirror" A Paramount Artcraft Picture
other_text: IN the dark mirror of dreams she saw herself... Dragged out of what she saw? Her other self? Or the crime and shame of the under-world? Here is the story of a magic, aged strife of excitement.
description: A vintage movie poster features Dorothy Dalton with a dramatic expression, surrounded by three men in a shadowy setting.
